claim: Dedicated Hosts provide visibility of the number of sockets and physical cores, while Dedicated Instances provide no such visibility.
question: Which dedicated option shows the number of sockets and physical cores, which matters for per-socket or per-core licenses?

values.display: visibility of the number of sockets and physical cores
values.spoken: Dedicated Hosts show sockets and cores
Dedicated Instances show no sockets or cores

qualifiers.scope: per Dedicated Host or per Dedicated Instance
